name: React Checkbox Component with Demo
description: Create a reusable React checkbox component with browser demo and WCAG 2.1 AA support

requirement.summary: Implement a TypeScript React checkbox component with browser-testable demo
details: Create named export function Checkbox with TypeScript support
Implement props: checked (boolean), onChange (function), label (string), disabled (boolean)
Support keyboard: Space bar to toggle when focused
Include ARIA: aria-label and aria-checked attributes
Create single-file demo (demo/index.html) for browser testing
Write unit tests verifying each AC
Document with usage example in README

demo_browser_tests.ac_3_space_key: Tab to checkbox, press Space, verify state toggles
demo_browser_tests.ac_7_focus_style: Tab to checkbox, verify focus outline visible
demo_browser_tests.ac_2_disabled: Click disabled checkbox, verify no state change
demo_browser_tests.ac_8_readme: Open README.md, verify usage example present

constraints.demo: single HTML file with test instructions

acceptance_criteria.claim: Props interface: checked (boolean), onChange (func), label (string), disabled (boolean)
Space key toggles checked state when focused
acceptance_criteria.test: Unit test: keydown Space → state changes

acceptance_criteria.claim: ARIA attributes: aria-label and aria-checked present

acceptance_criteria.verification: Test output shows coverage %; no specific threshold enforced

acceptance_criteria.test: Code inspection: className contains Tailwind utilities

acceptance_criteria.verification: README.md contains 'import { Checkbox }' and JSX example
